mapper.select:
select pp.id as id, pp.year as year, pp.image_url as imageUrl, pp.spu_no as spuNo, pp.name as name, pp.product_status as productStatusName, pp.category as category, pp.grade as grade, pp.charge_name as chargeName, pp.survey_date as surveyDate, pp.plan_survey_date as planSurveyDate, pp.project_approval_date as projectApprovalDate, pp.plan_project_approval_date as planProjectApprovalDate, pp.plan_first_mass_stock_in_date as planFirstMassStockInDate, pp.plan_listing_date as planListingDate, pp.project_approval_date as projectApprovalDate, pp.first_mass_stock_in_date as firstMassStockInDate, pp.listing_date as listingDate, pp.create_user_name as createUserName, pp.create_time as createTime, ppr.remark from product_plan pp left join (select product_plan_id,remark from product_plan_remark where is_deleted = false and remark != '' order by id desc limit 1 ) ppr on pp.id = ppr.product_plan_id
pp.is_deleted = false
and pp.product_status = ''
and pp.product_status in ('3','4','5','6')
and pp.product_status in ('4','5','6')
and pp.name like concat('%',#{params.name},'%')
and
string_to_array(pp.charge_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and
string_to_array(pp.category_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and pp.plan_survey_date >= #{params.planSurveyDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_survey_date <= #{params.planSurveyDateEnd}::timestamp
and pp.plan_project_approval_date >= #{params.planProjectApprovalDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_project_approval_date <= #{params.planProjectApprovalDateEnd}::timestamp
and pp.plan_first_mass_stock_in_date >= #{params.planFirstMassStockInDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_first_mass_stock_in_date <= #{params.planFirstMassStockInDateEnd}::timestamp
and pp.plan_listing_date >= #{params.planListingDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_listing_date <= #{params.planListingDateEnd}::timestamp
${params.param}
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
pp.create_time asc

select pp.id as productPlanId, pp.year as year, pp.charge_name as chargeName, pp.brand_name as brandName, pp.category as category, pp.grade as grade, pp.product_style as productStyleName, pp.product_type as productTypeName, pp.three_generation_planning as threeGenerationPlanningName, pp.name as name, pp.name_en as nameEn, pp.patent as patent, pp.competitive_product_link as competitiveProductLink, pp.spu_no as spuNo, pp.sku_qty as skuQtyStr, pp.specification as specification, pp.application_scenario as applicationScenario, pp.scene_category as sceneCategory, pp.application_scenario_desc as applicationScenarioDesc, pp.selling_point_desc as selling_point_desc, pps.sales_target_country as salesTargetCountry, pps.sales_platform as salesPlatformName, pps.price_cny as priceCnyStr, pps.price_usd as priceUsdStr, case when pp.is_need_id_design = false then '否' else '是' end as isNeedIDDesignStr, case when pp.is_need_structural_design = false then '否' else '是' end as isNeedStructuralDesignStr, ppp.target_cost as targetCostStr, ppp.estimated_mold_cost as estimatedMoldCostStr, ppp.supplier_status as supplierStatus, ppp.main_supplier_name as mainSupplierName, to_char(pp.plan_survey_date, 'yyyy/MM/dd') as planSurveyDateStr, to_char(pp.plan_project_approval_date, 'yyyy/MM/dd') as planProjectApprovalDateStr, to_char(pp.plan_first_mass_stock_in_date, 'yyyy/MM/dd') as planFirstMassStockInDateStr, pp.plan_marketing_season as planMarketingSeasonName, to_char(pp.plan_listing_date, 'yyyy/MM/dd') as planListingDateStr from product_plan pp left join product_plan_purchase ppp on pp.id = ppp.product_plan_id and ppp.is_deleted = false left join product_plan_sale pps on pp.id = pps.product_plan_id and pps.is_deleted = false left join (select product_plan_id,string_agg(remark,',') from product_plan_remark where is_deleted = false and remark != '' group by product_plan_id )ppr on pp.id = ppr.product_plan_id
pp.is_deleted = false
and pp.product_status = ''
and pp.product_status in ('3','4','5','6')
and pp.product_status in ('4','5','6')
and pp.name like concat('%',#{params.name},'%')
and
string_to_array(pp.charge_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and
string_to_array(pp.category_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and pp.plan_survey_date >= #{params.planSurveyDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_survey_date <= #{params.planSurveyDateEnd}::timestamp
and pp.plan_project_approval_date >= #{params.planProjectApprovalDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_project_approval_date <= #{params.planProjectApprovalDateEnd}::timestamp
and pp.plan_first_mass_stock_in_date >= #{params.planFirstMassStockInDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_first_mass_stock_in_date<= #{params.planFirstMassStockInDateEnd}::timestamp
and pp.plan_listing_date >= #{params.planListingDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_listing_date <= #{params.planListingDateEnd}::timestamp
${params.param}
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
pp.create_time asc

select count(0) from product_plan pp
pp.is_deleted = false
and pp.create_time >= #{startTime}::timestamp
and pp.create_time <= #{endTime}::timestamp
and pp.year = #{params.year}
and
string_to_array(pp.charge_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and
string_to_array(pp.grade_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and
string_to_array(pp.category_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')

select count(0) from product_plan pp left join product_status_time pst on pp.product_id = pst.product_id and pst.is_deleted = false left join project_status_time pjst on pp.product_id = pjst.product_id and pjst.is_deleted = false
pp.is_deleted = false
and pp.product_status = '' or pp.product_status = '1'
and pp.product_status = '3'
and pst.status = '3' and pst.status_time >= #{startTime}::timestamp and pst.status_time <= #{endTime}::timestamp
and pp.project_approval_date > pp.plan_project_approval_date
and pp.product_status = '5'
and pjst.status = '2' and pjst.status_time >= #{startTime}::timestamp and pjst.status_time <= #{endTime}::timestamp
and pp.product_status = '6'
and pjst.status = '3' and pjst.status_time >= #{startTime}::timestamp and pjst.status_time <= #{endTime}::timestamp
and pp.product_status = '7'
and ((pjst.status = '4' and pjst.status_time >= #{startTime}::timestamp and pjst.status_time <= #{endTime}::timestamp) or (pst.status = '4' and pst.status_time >= #{startTime}::timestamp and pst.status_time <= #{endTime}::timestamp))
and pp.year = #{params.year}
and
string_to_array(pp.charge_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and
string_to_array(pp.grade_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and
string_to_array(pp.category_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
group by pp.id

select ${params.groupFields}, count(0) as totalCount, (select count(0) from product_plan where product_status = '3' and ${params.groupField} = pp.${params.groupField}) as approvalCount, (select count(0) from product_plan where product_status in ('4','5','6') and ${params.groupField} = pp.${params.groupField}) as progressCount, (select count(0) from product_plan where product_status = '6' and ${params.groupField} = pp.${params.groupField}) as completeCount, (select count(0) from product_plan where product_status = '3' and project_approval_date > plan_project_approval_date and ${params.groupField} = pp.${params.groupField}) as approvalDelayCount, (select count(0) from product_plan where product_status = '7' and ${params.groupField} = pp.${params.groupField}) as cancelCount from product_plan pp
pp.is_deleted = false
and pp.year = #{params.year}
and
string_to_array(pp.charge_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and
string_to_array(pp.grade_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and
string_to_array(pp.category_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
group by pp.${params.groupFields}
